name: Multiple Cart Fee – Custom Extra Charges, Surcharges & Conditional Fees for WooCommerce
author: VerseSofts

sections.description:
Multiple Cart Fee for WooCommerce by VerseSofts empowers you to create unlimited conditional fees for your WooCommerce store. It is the perfect professional solution for adding handling fees, service charges, customized packaging costs, or product-based surcharges automatically during checkout.

If your pricing structure requires dynamic cart adjustments that WooCommerce core doesn’t support, this plugin provides the flexibility and power to implement those rules effortlessly.

Key Features

  • Add Unlimited Fees: Create multiple fees with custom names and exact amounts or percentages.
  • Conditional Logic: Automatically apply fees based precisely on the products, categories, or tags currently in the customer’s cart.
  • Cart Value Rules: Set minimum and maximum cart subtotals to define exactly when a fee should be applied.
  • Tax Support: Full capability to enable tax calculations for applied fees and select specific tax classes.
  • Variation Support: Works flawlessly with both simple and variable WooCommerce products.
  • HPOS Ready: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage for maximum database speed.
  • Lightweight & Fast: Clean, intuitive admin interface that ensures your store remains lightning fast.

Perfect For

  • Handling & Service: Stores needing to enforce extra handling or service fees on specific items.
  • Special Packaging: Shops with fragile items requiring crating, cooling, or special delivery surcharges.
  • Restocking/Processing: Businesses that charge category-based or product-based processing fees.
  • B2B & Wholesale: B2B WooCommerce stores needing advanced fee control for bulk orders under a certain threshold.

Professional Tools

  • Dynamic fee calculation based instantly on cart contents.
  • Bulk management interface for complex multiple fee rules.
  • Intuitive and modern settings panel seamlessly integrated into WooCommerce.
  • Built strictly to WooCommerce core coding standards.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Multiple Cart Fee for WooCommerce.
  3. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  4. Go to WooCommerce > Settings > Multiple Cart Fees to configure your rule sets.

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin from WordPress.org.
  2. Upload the entire unzipped multiple-cart-fee-for-woocommerce folder directly to /wp-content/plugins/.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Multiple Cart Fees to begin setup.
sections.faq:
Can I add multiple different fees to a single checkout?

Yes. You can add unlimited fees with different names, amounts, and triggering conditions running simultaneously.

Does the fee engine work with variable products?

Absolutely. The plugin deeply integrates with WooCommerce to support both simple and variable products without issue.

Can I set cart subtotal amount limits?

Yes. You can easily define minimum and maximum cart totals to restrict when a fee application is valid.

Can I apply fees targeting a specific category or product tag?

Yes. You can target specific categories, exact products, or overarching product tags to trigger the extra charge.

Where can I get support for this plugin?

We offer dedicated support for our users:
* Website: VerseSofts.com
* Support Email: contact@versesofts.com
